reference_format.note: County-matters applications on the consolidated register are SCC/<serial>/<year>. Legacy district-numbered references also appear on it, for conditions applications inherited from the pre-2023 districts, so no single pattern describes the register.

quirks.summary: A disclaimer gate precedes everything; without the AcceptedDisclaimer cookie a cold document download 302s back to the disclaimer and returns HTML under the requested filename.
quirks.detail: POST /Disclaimer/Accept?returnUrl=<path> with an explicit Content-Length: 0 header — the front end 411s a plain empty POST. The cookie lasts about an hour, so a long run has to re-accept.
quirks.workaround: Accept the disclaimer on the same cookie jar before searching or downloading, and verify every download by magic bytes.

quirks.summary: The consolidated register holds county matters only — current district-level applications are still filed on surviving legacy Idox portals, so a search here returns no rows for them.
quirks.detail: Mendip: publicaccess.mendip.gov.uk/online-applications/ (Idox). South Somerset: publicaccess.southsomerset.gov.uk (Idox), whose documents sit on a separate host, ssdc.somerset.gov.uk/planningdocuments?ref_no=<enc-ref> (untested). A zero result on the consolidated register is a coverage gap, not evidence that the application does not exist.
quirks.workaround: Route first: query PlanIt with auth=Somerset and take the applics url/docs_url, which point at the portal that actually holds the application. See cohort_scope.

endpoints.note: Sweeps add District and DateReceivedFrom/To (dd/mm/yyyy) to the same POST.

cohort_scope.note: Somerset has been a unitary authority since 2023, but its planning record is still split across three live portals. 'Somerset Council's applications' is therefore NOT the same set as 'applications on planning.somerset.gov.uk'.

portals.holds: County matters — minerals and waste — under SCC/<serial>/<year> references, plus legacy district-numbered conditions applications.
Former Mendip district applications, including current 2026 filings.
Former South Somerset district applications, including current 2026 filings.

cohort_scope.router: PlanIt auth=Somerset: the applics records' url / docs_url fields say which of the three portals holds a given application.
cohort_scope.gaps: Whether the former Sedgemoor and Somerset West and Taunton areas have live legacy portals of their own was not established; only Mendip and South Somerset were recorded as still live.

source_notes:
POST-MERGER FRAGMENTATION (unitary since 2023): PlanIt still lists the legacy districts separately, and CURRENT 2026 applications are still filed on the legacy portals — Mendip publicaccess.mendip.gov.uk/online-applications/ (Idox) and South Somerset publicaccess.southsomerset.gov.uk (Idox; its docs live on ssdc.somerset.gov.uk/planningdocuments?ref_no=<enc-ref>, untested). Query PlanIt auth=Somerset to see which portal a given application lives on (applics url/docs_url point at the right host). The consolidated planning.somerset.gov.uk register is DEF ATRIUM (PlanIt scraper_type 'Atrium') and covers county matters (minerals/waste, SCC/NNNN/YYYY refs + legacy district-numbered conditions apps). Atrium chain: DISCLAIMER GATE first — POST /Disclaimer/Accept?returnUrl=<path> with an explicit 'Content-Length: 0' header (411 without it) -> AcceptedDisclaimer cookie (~1h), required for downloads (cold download 302s to disclaimer). Search: POST /Search/Results with __RequestVerificationToken pair + SearchPlanning=True + AdvancedSearch=True (+ District/DateReceivedFrom/To dd/mm/yyyy for sweeps). Detail: GET /Planning/Display?applicationNumber=<enc-ref>. Docs: /Document/Download?module=PLA&recordNumber=&planId=&imageId=&isPlan=&fileName= (identical scheme to Welwyn Hatfield — this identification is what re-classified Recipe A as the DEF Atrium product).

One authority, three live portals (Atrium county register + 2 legacy Idox); PlanIt applics records are the router.
